summary: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Work, an agentic feature that can take actions across a user's apps and files and persist on a task for hours to complete a project.

mechanisms.reason: The product is described as an agent that acts across apps and files and persists on tasks for extended periods, reflecting a shift toward agent-executed work.
mechanisms.quote: ChatGPT Work is an agent that can take action across your apps and files, stay with a project for hours if needed, and turn a goal into finished work.

practices.reason: The summary gestures at an agent scaffolding pattern (persistent, multi-app, long-horizon task execution) but gives no implementable detail on how it is built.
